contract.return_mechanism: A 16-register x86_64 fault reply updates RAX and FaultIP while preserving faulted RSP/RFLAGS and TLS state.
contract.user_continuation_proof: The current M2 probe compares RAX with 4242 before issuing a bounded write and verified exit; this M1 getpid proof is therefore retained as a subsumed baseline.

required_serial_markers: SeLinOS ABI gateway: getpid, write, mmap, brk, ROMFS open/read/close, EOF read and exit(0) mediated.
SeLinOS M0: thirty runnable isolated service domains and one suspended child fixture configured.
forbidden_serial_markers: SeLinOS ABI gateway: Linux syscall ABI probe failed.
SeLinOS M0: isolated domain bootstrap FAILED.
limitations: M1 getpid evidence is subsumed by the stronger current M2 getpid/write/exit probe; it is not a general Linux userspace ABI.
The temporary gateway runs in the root task and is not yet the persistent isolated selinos-abi-gated server.
No read, brk, mmap, VFS, dynamic linker, glibc, network, dpkg, or apt compatibility is claimed.
